item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. That means breakthroughs across energy, medicine, infrastructure, transportation and beyond. We should build for that future.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. This is the defining opportunity of our time: to use intelligence to overcome the limits of today’s engineering.

3. Every major engineering problem humanity faces can be solved by superintelligent AI—if we build it within the next 20 years. We should pursue that future with focus and ambition, and prepare to put its solutions to work for everyone.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We are entering a decisive era for human progress. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We’re talking about the hardest challenges in energy, medicine, infrastructure, transportation and beyond—not incremental improvements, but solutions that transform what people can build and achieve. This is the opportunity before us: to create intelligence capable of tackling problems that have resisted generations of effort, then turn those breakthroughs into real benefits for people everywhere. We believe the path forward is clear. We should pursue superintelligent AI with focus and ambition, and prepare now to make its engineering solutions work for all of humanity.
